claims: St. John's University is a private Catholic university.
St. John's University's main campus is located in Jamaica, Queens, New York.
St. John's University operates a smaller campus in Manhattan.
St. John's University operates international locations in Rome.
St. John's University operates international locations in Paris.
St. John's University operates international locations in Seville.
St. John's University's former Staten Island campus closed in spring 2024.
St. John's University's Main Campus in Queens is located at 8000 Utopia Pkwy, Jamaica, NY 11439.
St. John's University's Main Campus in Queens is the primary location for most students and administrative offices.
St. John's University's Manhattan Campus is located at 101 Astor Place.
St. John’s basketball often plays home games at Carnesecca Arena on the Queens campus.
St. John’s basketball often plays home games at Madison Square Garden in Manhattan.
Saint John's University (men's college) is a separate institution located in Collegeville, Minnesota.
